description: Godot game: change the running game with ops in order: set properties, call a method (returns its value, awaits coroutines), spawn, remove, change/reload scene. Stops at the first failing op; earlier ops stay (no undo, nothing saved).

action.description: set {path, properties} | call {path, method, args} | spawn {class or scene, parent, name, properties} | remove {path} | change_scene {scene; omit to reload}

path.description: Node path: relative to the current scene (default ".") or /root/....

name: godot_game_edit
title: Change live game
